bar.publication_gate: maximum over all frozen scored sites of max(h_e,v_e) <= 0.05
bar.reason: 0.05 is the largest round threshold below the 0.0533 lower 95 percent bound of the confirmed 0.0634 merge-created rim; the matched no-merge upper 95 percent bound is 0.0033. No current M3 output was inspected to select it.
bar.effect_on_existing_scorecard: tightens it: the scorecard's p99 and one-percent prevalence tuple can admit up to five of 500 observed sites above 0.05, while the owner's word no cannot

instrument_changes_from_m152_v1: v_e is max(v_e_negative_side,v_e_positive_side), not the pooled two-side mean
v_e uses the broad [-400,-320] and [320,400] source-plateau step; h_e and edge width retain the narrow [-64,-48] and [48,64] step
the owner-facing headline gate consumes the observed maximum max(h_e,v_e)
rho_edge remains a phase-consistency diagnostic; the 10-90 edge-width ratio is the non-compensating blur guard

clean_noise_null.failure_action: checker not admitted; do not raise thresholds after seeing a candidate

required: median v_e exceeds the clean-noise null
at least one M3 gate fails
median h_e decreases by at least 0.05
median v_e decreases by at least 0.05
Gaussian blur fails the edge-width guard
the clean paired arm passes both

sparse_headline_control.plant: one of 500 sites receives the one-sided 6 percent veil
required: the prior scorecard tuple without that maximum passes

warp.fit_holdout_split: even indices fit; odd indices score
warp.null: identity plus independent 0.008-pixel coordinate noise must return nonzero residual and pass
warp.degradation: scale 1.0025, rotation 0.05 degrees, translation (+0.45,-0.30) must fail
warp.improvement: the fit-half inverse applied to held-out landmarks must pass all geometry limits
warp.profile_guard: a clean profile population with independently bounded residual shifts of +/-0.08 native pixel must pass, and the same residuals must not hide the one-sided 6 percent veil

commissioning.admission_rule: every listed assertion must pass in one run; otherwise NOT_ADMITTED_COMMISSIONING_FAILED

measurement.required_input: identical hashed native-size uncompressed 16-bit linear ProPhoto RGB D50 TIFFs
measurement.required_geometry: input-derived scale disagreement <=0.10 percent, rotation disagreement <=0.02 degrees, and nontranslation residual <=0.10 output pixel RMS for every capture and arm
measurement.score: absolute M3 gates plus strehl paired p99 no worse than the best required comparator
